method: Contact sheets of all actual atlas crops in this scope, followed by full-resolution review and pixel-divider measurement of six affected originals, and visual reinspection of all corrected crops. This is not specialist anatomy, sports instruction or all-library certification.

issues.finding: Equal-division cuts did not follow the actual grid: adjacent labels, hair or soles could enter the tile, or current edges were truncated.
issues.resolution: Measured original dividers, using gutter centers where present; rechecked the corrected contact sheets.
